svg.title: XGBoost CART tree, chess 1M, depth limit 10
svg.text: squared error = Gini on 256 histogram bins (CART-like) · hopper (NVIDIA H100 PCIe) · XGBoost 3.4.1
chess 3x3, 1M rows (80/20) · no pruning · timed: QuantileDMatrix + xgb.train from the host float32 arrays, after a warm-up fit
run: xgb.train(objective='reg:squarederror', lambda=0, eta=1, tree_method='hist', max_bin=256, max_depth=10, device='cuda'), 1 round
check: the drawn tree predicts all 200,000 test rows as XGBoost's own predict() does
left branch: the condition holds (yes). Hover a node for its numbers.
